confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cartagena pricing, not from live listings or current prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident, with a tourist-area premium over Bogota and Medellin. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because they vary by season and neighbourhood (Getsemani, Centro, Bocagrande). Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship plus general knowledge; wine is the weakest restaurant anchor because imported-wine pricing varies widely. FX caveat: the RBA observation below is the most recent one I could retrieve (20 March 2026), not the latest available on the 2026-10-16 generation date. I could not verify a newer RBA value from a source I could read directly, so the server should refresh the fx observation before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Colombian Caribbean coast tourist pricing, using Santa Marta and similar mid-sized Latin American tourist cities as reference points, adjusted upward for Cartagena's heritage-district tourist demand and for lodging, which is priced above the Colombian average. No single named comparable city was used.
